Name: CHAOS_MATCHING_MUTATION_ENEMY_TABLE_PARAM_ST
Description: Deep of Night enemy mutations: which enemies (by map, site variation and mutation ID range) can be mutated, in which mutation category, and under which map-pattern modifiers.

Fields.Name: Category ID
Fields.Description: Used with ChaosMatchingMutationCategoryParam, for determining which mutation category to use.

Fields.Name: Mutation Count
Fields.Description: How many mutation IDs after Mutation ID the row also covers.

Fields.Name: Is Team Mutation
Fields.Description: Used for groups, mutates all members with incremented mutation ID.

Fields.Name: Mutation ID
Fields.Description: First mutation ID (set on the enemy in the map) covered by this row. An enemy matches when its ID is from this value to this value + Mutation Count.

Fields.Name: Small Base Map ID
Fields.Description: Site map of the enemies, as AABB (3410 = m34_10); used when Field Map is 0. The enemy must also be in the site variation given by Variation ID.

Fields.Name: Variation ID
Fields.Description: Variation of the site (Small Base Map ID) the enemies must be in.

Fields.Name: Field Map
Fields.Description: Open-field tile of the enemies, as 60XXYY (604338 = m60_43_38); an enemy matches only on this tile, and only on its Shifting Earth version when Modifier ID 1 is a Shifting Earth modifier. 0: the row uses Small Base Map ID instead.

Fields.Name: Required Modifier 1
Fields.Description: With Required Modifier 2: if either is set, at least one of them must be an active map-pattern modifier for the row to be used. On a field-tile row, a Shifting Earth modifier (11-15) also makes the row match only that Shifting Earth version of the tile. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Required Modifier 2
Fields.Description: With Modifier ID 1: if either is set, at least one of them must be an active map-pattern modifier for the row to be used. 0: none. Retail: 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Excluded Modifier 1
Fields.Description: The row is not used while this map-pattern modifier is active. 0: none. Retail: the Shifting Earth (11-15) that reshapes the row's field tile.

Fields.Name: Excluded Modifier 3
Fields.Description: The row is not used while this map-pattern modifier is active (like Modifier ID 2 and 3). 0: none. Retail: 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Excluded Modifier 4
Fields.Description: As Excluded Modifier 3. 0: none. Retail: 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Excluded Modifier 5
Fields.Description: As Excluded Modifier 3. 0: none. Retail: 0 on every row.
